title: Anthropic names global affairs chief to lead AI diplomacy as Trump tensions escalate
excerpt: Anthropic named Mariano-Florentino Cuellar its first chief global affairs officer as the AI company navigates a Pentagon blacklist and export control fights
content_html:
TL;DR

Anthropic named Tino Cuellar its first chief global affairs officer to manage government ties amid Pentagon blacklist and export fights

Anthropic has named Mariano-Florentino Cuellar its first chief global affairs officer, hiring a veteran policy hand at a moment when the AI company’s relationship with the US government remains deeply strained.

Cuellar will report to Anthropic president Daniela Amodei and work from the company’s San Francisco headquarters, a spokesperson told Reuters.

His job will include managing relationships with the US government and the growing number of countries where Anthropic is expanding.

Cuellar, who goes by Tino, is a former California Supreme Court justice and most recently served as president of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, a role he held until July.

He also served as a special assistant in Barack Obama’s White House, where he worked on regulatory policy and public safety. At Carnegie, he co-chaired a bipartisan task force on nuclear proliferation and US national security, a domain some AI leaders have cited as a model for governing the technology’s risks.

A 2025 study co-led by Cuellar helped inform the passage of California’s SB 53, the first US law focused specifically on AI safety. Anthropic endorsed the bill, which protects AI whistleblowers, requires high-revenue developers to report on safety standards and incidents, and carries a maximum fine of one million dollars per violation.

Cuellar has been on Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust since January, the independent body that exists to hold the company to its public benefit mission. He is stepping down from that role to take the job, and the trust is looking for a replacement to what was a four-member group.

The hire comes after a turbulent year for Anthropic’s government relations. The Pentagon designated the company a supply-chain risk in March after Anthropic refused to let its Claude models be used for autonomous weapons or mass surveillance of Americans. Anthropic sued the government over the blacklisting, and the case is still in court.

More recently, the Trump administration imposed export controls on Anthropic’s most advanced AI models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, over national security concerns. The ban was lifted after roughly three weeks once Anthropic agreed to a set of security commitments, but the episode underscored how fraught the company’s position in Washington has become.

Oren Cass, founder of the conservative think tank American Compass and a friend of Cuellar, told Reuters that the new hire would be “open-minded” to the Trump administration’s positions and eager to find the root of any disagreement.

Cuellar himself said in a statement that policymakers had reached an “inflection point” on AI governance, adding that the choices made now would determine whether humanity harnesses extraordinary possibilities or faces enormous risk.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Anthropic 任命 Tino Cuellar 为首位首席全球事务官，负责在五角大楼黑名单和出口斗争中管理政府关系

Anthropic 任命马里亚诺-弗洛伦蒂诺·奎利亚尔 (Mariano-Florentino Cuellar) 为首位首席全球事务官，在这家人工智能公司与美国政府的关系仍然非常紧张之际，聘请了一位经验丰富的政策专家。

一位发言人告诉路透社，奎利亚尔将向 Anthropic 总裁 Daniela Amodei 汇报工作，并在公司旧金山总部工作。

他的工作将包括管理与美国政府以及 Anthropic 正在扩张的越来越多国家的关系。

奎利亚尔（昵称蒂诺）是前加州最高法院法官，最近担任卡内基国际和平基金会主席，一直担任到今年 7 月。

他还曾担任巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)白宫的特别助理，负责监管政策和公共安全。 在卡内基，他担任了一个关于核扩散和美国国家安全的两党特别工作组的联合主席，一些人工智能领导人将这一领域视为治理技术风险的典范。

Cuellar 共同领导的一项 2025 年研究帮助加州通过了 SB 53，这是美国第一部专门针对人工智能安全的法律。 Anthropic 批准了该法案，该法案保护人工智能举报人，要求高收入开发商报告安全标准和事件，每次违规最高可处以 100 万美元的罚款。

Cuellar 自一月份以来一直加入 Anthropic 的长期利益信托基金，该独立机构的存在是为了让公司履行其公共利益使命。 他将从这个职位上辞职并接手这份工作，信托基金正在寻找替代者来取代原来的四人小组。

此次任命是在 Anthropic 的政府关系经历了动荡的一年之后进行的。 三月份，在 Anthropic 拒绝将其克劳德模型用于自主武器或对美国人进行大规模监视后，五角大楼将该公司认定为供应链风险。 Anthropic就黑名单起诉政府，目前案件仍在法庭审理中。

最近，出于国家安全考虑，特朗普政府对 Anthropic 最先进的人工智能模型《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》实施了出口管制。 大约三周后，Anthropic 同意一系列安全承诺后，该禁令被解除，但这一事件突显了该公司在华盛顿的地位已变得多么令人担忧。

保守派智库“美国指南针”创始人、奎利亚尔的朋友奥伦·卡斯告诉路透社，新员工将对特朗普政府的立场“持开放态度”，并渴望找到任何分歧的根源。

奎利亚尔本人在一份声明中表示，政策制定者已经达到了人工智能治理的“拐点”，并补充说，现在做出的选择将决定人类是利用非凡的可能性还是面临巨大的风险。
